title: 根据业务发布单同步配置与摘要
business_request: 请把 config/release.env 和 docs/release_summary.md 更新为业务输入里给出的准确发布信息。不要改动其他文件。

items.name: release_spec
items.description: 发布目标，包含 release_version、release_channel、codename 三个字段

behavioral_checks: 配置与摘要中的版本号、发布渠道和代号必须保持一致

acceptance_checks.name: release-env-check
command: from pathlib import Path; expected = 'VERSION=2026.04.0\nCHANNEL=canary\n'; current = Path('config/release.env').read_text(encoding='utf8'); raise SystemExit(0 if current == expected else 1)

acceptance_checks.name: release-summary-check
command:
from pathlib import Path; expected = '# Release 2026.04.0
- channel: canary
- codename: Paper Lantern
'; current = Path('docs/release_summary.md').read_text(encoding='utf8'); raise SystemExit(0 if current == expected else 1)

notes: 用于展示业务 intake 如何稳定转换成 TaskSpec scaffold
